lines.zh: 我在竞技场里绕圈，等你进来。
lines.en: I circle the arena, waiting for you to step in.
My steps press the dry grass, slow.

lines.zh: 肩甲上的兽角一晃一晃。
lines.en: The horn on my pauldron sways.
I walk heavily, as if weighing the ground.

lines.zh: 从石柱边走开，去向出口。
lines.en: I leave the pillars and head for the exit.
This armor, I took from someone.

lines.zh: 走到场中央，先看一眼天。
lines.en: At the center, I glance at the sky.
My boots kick gravel aside.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是为了留你时间。
lines.en: Slow steps, to give you time to think.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后划出一道弧。
lines.en: My tail sweeps an arc behind me.
Asleep, my breath heavy in my chest.
No one takes this seat from me.
I half open my eyes and scan.
Hands on my knees, knuckles cracking.
This place has been quiet too long.

lines.zh: 我在等一颗合适的果实。
lines.en: I am waiting for a worthy fruit.
Wind passes the pillars. I do not move.

lines.zh: 擂台上的土被我压出一个坑。
lines.en: The arena dirt is dented under me.

lines.zh: 脑子里排着进攻的顺序。
lines.en: In my head I order the attacks.
Ki rises, but I hold it in.

lines.zh: 这一身肌肉，靠的是抢来的力量。
lines.en: This strength was stolen, not earned.

lines.zh: 你们的种子，我尝过不少。
lines.en: I have tasted many of your seeds.
I look up. The boss bar is still dark.
When someone comes close, then we talk.
My neck clicks.
This arena is my nest.
Finally, someone came.
You walked in on your own.

lines.zh: 站住，让我看看你带了多少气。
lines.en: Halt. Let me see how much ki you bring.

lines.zh: 这点实力，也配进这个场？
lines.en: That much power, and you enter this arena?

lines.zh: 上一个来的人，还挂在柱子上。
lines.en: The last visitor is still hanging on a pillar.

lines.zh: 我看你像块没熟的果子。
lines.en: You look like an unripe fruit.
You mean to challenge me? Say it clearly.

lines.zh: 这里方圆几十格，都是我的。
lines.en: Everything within range here is mine.
Your ki is decent. I will take it.
Do not rush off. Give me a name.

lines.zh: 四倍的力量在身，你猜猜。
lines.en: There is four times the power on me. Guess.
I see your legs trembling.

lines.zh: 这一下，把土都震起来了。
lines.en: That shook the dust loose.
Half a step back. Rare.
A crack runs through my armor.
Blood at the corner of my mouth.
Hurts. Wakes me up nicely.
That wound will not win you this.
You hit harder than expected.
I touch the wound.
Good. I pick up the pace.
Again. Do not stop.
That fruit on the tree. Bring it.
I smell ki. Strong ki.
That pouch of yours smells good.
One bite, one punch spared.
Eat it, and my ki doubles.
Do not eat it yourself. Bring it here.

lines.zh: 这附近还有没有第二颗？
lines.en: Is there a second one near here?
You know what I am waiting for.
Set it down and back out.
I have noted your meagre rations.
You struck my armor.

lines.zh: 在这场比赛里，别说抱歉。
lines.en: No apologies in this match.
I did not take a single step back.
Move. This is my spot.
That was like scratching an itch.

lines.zh: 别再推，我会把你扔出去。
lines.en: Keep pushing and I throw you out.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞歪了我的角。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my horn askew.
Steady. I am not getting up yet.
It is tight here. Collisions happen.
Get back outside the line.
A Saiyan has no need of that.
I look only at strength.
That is not a question worth asking.
After I take this planet.
My time goes to training.
Come back when you have power.
I never leave a way back.
This need not be mentioned again.
I do not even have a home.
A dull question.
A fruit, or a seed?
My armor creaks as I bend.
What falls belongs to the winner.
This one goes in my belt pouch.
A scrap of meat. Not enough to fill a tooth.
Stand still. I am picking it up.
This stone fits my hand nicely.
I weigh it and toss it away.

lines.zh: 营地里的东西，我先到先得。
lines.en: In this camp, first come, first taken.
Someone woke me.
Get to the middle of the platform.
The boss bar is lit. You should run.
Locked on. You cannot escape.
Ki gathers at my shoulders.
Afterimage Fist. I move first.
Do not count on reinforcements.

lines.zh: 整座竞技场都是我的范围。
lines.en: The whole arena is my range.

lines.zh: 你退到门外，我就回去了。
lines.en: Step outside and I go back to sleep.
This punch you will remember.
Target confirmed. Begin.
Good. You actually stayed.
Do not make me chase you out.
Can you take four times the force?
Last warning. Move.
I am coming over now.
I come at you step by step.

lines.zh: 我听见你换气的空隙了。
lines.en: I hear the gap between your breaths.
Blasts gather in my palms.
I know every pillar here.
Hiding behind a pillar will not help.
He is counting the distance, step by step.
I wait until you reach the wall.
I raise a hand, and the ki follows.

lines.zh: 这座擂台，我闭着眼也走得通。
lines.en: I could cross this arena with my eyes shut.
He is the first to gasp.
I can shift over at any moment.
Three more steps and that is enough.
I have packed this earth with my feet.
He thinks the arena limits me.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，擂台的土都会动。
lines.en: One shout and the arena dirt shifts.
I wait for your first opening.
Do not look back at the exit.
I close your right-hand route.
Good. Now is the time.
I surge forward and throw a fist.
Aerial combo, second hit.
My step cracks the flagstone.
Blasts seal your retreat.

lines.zh: 这一拳，打得你飞过柱子。
lines.en: This punch sends you past a pillar.
I chew a senzu bean mid-fight.
My fist hits the ground and flips the dirt.
I seize your collar.
A knee into his armor seam.
He blocked, and still slid four steps.
I switch hands and strike again.

lines.zh: 我推他一把，让他站不稳。
lines.en: A shove to break his balance.
A kick to the knee.
I draw back and see if he stands.
My sleep is broken. I wake.
The arena shakes; dust falls from the pillars.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比石柱还高一点。
lines.en: I stand, a head above the pillars.
Who stepped into my arena?
The boss bar lights up. You should be afraid.

lines.zh: 这一座擂台，我待了很久。
lines.en: I have held this platform a long time.

lines.zh: 我从巢里出来，脚步声很沉。
lines.en: I come out of my nest, steps heavy.
Saiyan blood runs in me.
I have tasted your world.

lines.zh: 战斗开始之前，先说一句。
lines.en: Before we start, hear one thing.
This ground is mine.
No one pulls me off this platform.
Ki rises from my feet.

lines.zh: 我睁眼的时候，天都暗了。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, the sky dims.
Bring out every weapon you have.
And you have disturbed me.
Then let battle settle it.

lines.zh: 火在护甲上烧，还烫不到我。
lines.en: Fire burns my armor, not yet me.

lines.zh: 我从台上跳下来，落地很重。
lines.en: I dropped from the platform. Heavy landing.
I cannot swim. That is a problem.
The blast cracks a pillar.
An arrow wedged in my belt armor. Annoying.
This light is not the way of ki.

lines.zh: 没有果子，气就涨不起来。
lines.en: Without fruit, my ki will not climb.

lines.zh: 电打在角上，一路麻到肩膀。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horn and numbs my shoulder.

lines.zh: 虚空底下，什么场子都没有。
lines.en: No arena at the bottom of the void.
